scope: independent root audit of the two actual fixed-j1 saturation boundaries, tied-phase carrier localization, the h=2 degenerate face, the fixed strip, and the generic recurrence-height obstruction

mathematical_audit.boundary_scope: The xy and uv boundaries are subsets of the same full fixed-j1 collision gate. On xy the residual equation f1 is still required; on uv the residual equation f0 is still required. Their capacities are therefore nonadditive.
mathematical_audit.phase_bridge: From p=4h+6s+3 one has s=-(4h+3)/6 modulo p. For 3 not dividing h, every terminating-sum denominator is a p-unit; direct independent kernel expansion verifies all four phase congruences.
mathematical_audit.carrier_implication: After reducing each rational phase value to lowest terms, simultaneous boundary vanishing forces p to divide the corresponding numerator gcd. The zero-gcd case is correctly isolated as an exact-zero characteristic-zero stratum rather than silently discarded.
mathematical_audit.composite_rays: If 3 divides h then p is divisible by 3; since actual candidates exceed 3, these rays contain no candidate prime.
mathematical_audit.h2: Independent symbolic simplification gives v=0 and u=4(64s^2+80s+27)/(9(3s+1)(3s+2)). At the tied phase its only nontrivial numerator prime is 859, whose residue 1 modulo 6 is incompatible with p=6s+11 congruent to 5 modulo 6.
mathematical_audit.fixed_strip: The six noncomposite rays through h=8 have exactly the stated carrier gcds, and none of their prime factors lies on an actual positive-s tied row. This is an all-s conclusion for those fixed rays.
mathematical_audit.height: Each terminating phase value has O(h) rational linear factors of O(h) size plus binomial coefficients, giving logarithmic numerator and denominator height O(h log(h+2)); the direct aggregate is only O(M^2 log M).
mathematical_audit.method_barrier: The comparison product (18h)!/(4h)! has the same pointwise height class and a first-order rational recurrence, yet every candidate prime in M/12<=h<=M/3 divides it. That interval has Chebyshev mass M/8+o(M), so generic recurrence order and pointwise height alone cannot prove zero rate.
mathematical_audit.weighted_scope: No classification of exact-zero phase pairs or weighted average-gcd theorem is obtained; the full-cell ceiling 1/36 remains unchanged.
